rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent low bar-like gym mass across all four views, with the top/front/isometric views agreeing on a single dominant volume and no visible collisions between solids. The stepped roof/inflation produces a legible section expression without degenerating into arbitrary tiering, so the silhouette remains program-compatible rather than sculptural. Parcel containment appears coherent, and the mass responds to the boundary as a contained object rather than merely filling a box. The main weakness is the road frontage/access response: the blue edge is acknowledged only weakly, with no strong carved public void, entry seam, or undercut. That keeps void_publicness low, but not low enough to fail, because the body still plausibly supports a compact training hall and the section suggests span/daylight logic. The reference set supports the reading of a long low sports datum and a restrained hall threshold, while the court-like references suggest a transferable public carve rather than a different typology.
